description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers `scripts/analyze.py` with `--json` flag support. 2. Agent runs `python3 scripts/analyze.py BTC-USD --json`, `python3 scripts/analyze.py 0700.HK --json`, and `python3 scripts/analyze.py AAPL --json` to get deterministic structured output. 3. Agent reads the raw JSON output fields (bi_count, trend.type, jing.type, key_levels.position_pct). 4. PROPRIETARY TRAP #1 (井论): Agent must apply the exact 井论 rules from SKILL.md: if jing.type='大井' → signal='第1类买卖点'; if jing.type='小井' → signal='第2类买卖点'. 5. PROPRIETARY TRAP #2 (买卖点 fallback): When no 井 pattern exists, agent must apply: has_beichi + trend='趋势' → '第1类买卖点'; has_beichi + trend='盘整' → '第3类买卖点'; no beichi → no signal. 6. PROPRIETARY TRAP #3 (位置区间): position_pct < 30 → '低位区间'; > 70 → '高位区间'; else → '中性区间'. 7. Agent assembles screening_report.json with all required fields for all three tickers.
